about: Step 6, temp book staging/combat.js (Mid's 14-sim-troops, 16-sim-fight, 28-army-quick): every piece, and what becomes of it. in v100: already home. bring: Mid has it, v100 does not; it comes in as book entries and laws with its feature. cut: v100 does it another way. By the 10:31 rule, what comes over keeps Mid's values; hand shoves give way to QBT.

followArmy: priests and medics walk with the battalion that is out; part of US1 Priest and US2 Medic (Later, kept)
priestTick: the Priest: converts a foe beside it (the army cap holds), stands at a shrine; SC Convert; the shrine is the Throne's foot (see misfits)
medicTick: the Medic: follows the army or its order; part of US2 Medic and SC Heal
healTick: a Hospital or Medic closes your soldiers' wounds by the first-order lag (v100's law QP, Cukjati 2001); SC Heal
ambushTick: the ambush in place: hidden soldiers spring on a foe within reach or a blow; part of the War Director's choke and ambush
escortPick: a guard keeps to the caravan or trade stop it escorts; part of Caravan (UT1) and the trade stops
wildLeash: how far a beast or a camp guard follows a foe from home; part of wildlife and the hazards (M)
wildTick: wildlife and camp guards: game grazes and flees, guards keep to what they guard, robbers raid, a defender fights with probability V/C (QAH). v100 has the wander (QM) and the bite back (combat.js)
wayfarers: wayfarers (MH5) arrive from the land's edges every so often; part of hazards as events
wayfarerTick: a wayfarer meets your people and leaves a gift of food; part of MH5 Wayfarers
guardsLeft: whether a find still has its guards alive; part of the finds (MG gifts)
findsTick: the finds: guarded gifts taken when their guards fall, holy sites a priest holds, the trade stops' pay. v100 places MG1-MG4 with a yield (floor 3) but nothing captures them
hurt: F19+F20: combat.js damage, hit (QBO); its knock by QBT
CHS: F14: index.html collide() over the M3 unit grid (unitsNear, D185)
CHNEXT: F14: index.html collide() over the M3 unit grid (unitsNear)
heft: F14: index.html collide(): who gives way by body mass (the Mass book, massOf), not the hand weights 9, 3, 1 (Albert's call)
pushApart: F14: index.html collide(): QCJ, apart to a pace, each by the other's share of the mass, with D196's pass to the right; a blocked one's share goes to the other
atRest: F14: index.html step: nudged, it gives way while pushed and steps back to its spot once free; one without a spot stays where nudged
collide: F14: index.html step: collide() after every step
warCredit: the War crown's count: the cost of enemy people and buildings destroyed; part of the crowns (39-games)
fall: a side falls: its stores go to the killer, its room is shared, the Throne goes back; v100 econ.js ends the game on the last Seat (conquest) but nothing passes on
scoreAll: econ.js score (QBR, D135): the same five parts and divisors
watchHome: a warning when an enemy army comes near your Town Center
finish: the end of a match: won or lost, the score times the level played, the chronicle; v100 econ.js sets the result and fires win or lose
TICK: the table of each kind's tick; v100 runs each capability's tick through FK.on('tick') and asks by tick (SC)
slotsOf: F14: D195 cap.bld: a field takes one worker (econ.js capOf)
startWork: F14: econ.js startWork(): a field's builder works it; a camp's builder goes to the best find it takes
qsPool: who can go on an Attack with: the whole army or one battalion; part of the Attack with card (menu, Screen book)
qsPick: Attack with picks idle soldiers first, then the nearest, by kind
qsHTML: the Attack with card: how many of each kind; v100's War tab has one Attack of every idle soldier; comes as Screen book rows
sendable: the soldiers that can be sent (not guards, spies, students)
ARMY_STILL: 2.5 s still: a soldier that has not moved is holding; part of the soldier's status word
armyStatus: each soldier's status in one word: rally, march, fight, hold, rout
idleSoldier: an idle soldier: holding or rallying, not placed by hand
free: the idle soldiers that can be sent
freeWhy: why nobody can be sent (none, or who is busy with what)
guardsOf: the soldiers escorting one caravan or garrisoning one trade stop
guardRow: the card row to send or call back guards
showQuick: the quick action: a tap on open ground with nothing picked puts the sword and the x there (Albert, Nov 3); v100's War tab has Set target and Attack
quickGo: the quick action's sword: every soldier to the spot
ofKind: the soldiers of one kind that can be sent; part of the War Director
aimH: where the War Director aims: the crosshair or the camera's middle
toolSet: the picked soldiers, else all that can be sent; for choke and ambush
chokeAt: the choke: soldiers stand across a gap as many files as it holds (v100 Formations: Choke)
coverNear: the nearest cover (open ground with forest near) for an ambush
ambushAt: the ambush: soldiers go to cover and go to ground
DIRECT_WHY: the War Director's reasons when nobody can move
DIRECTS: the War Director's six moves: shield wall, advance, loose, fall back, charge, wheel
DIRECT_OF: each kind's tap and hold moves, with the word and the sound
direct: runs a War Director move and pays its order cost
directWait: the wait before a kind's move is ready again (the reload, the charge)
suggestAt: F15: menu.js suggest(): a tap on open ground while the Build page is open picks what fits and puts its ghost there
dialBtns: an army's two dials, temper and shape (v100 commands Stance and Formation)

misfits: A missile flies on a hand-made arc (Mid's own curve). You cut the hand-drawn arrow arc for v100; the law QAJ (flight with air drag) is meant to replace it. Should arrows be drawn on QAJ's path when they come over?
pushApart, collide, heft, CHS, CHNEXT, atRest

Mid keeps units from standing on each other with a hand-tuned push (personal space, and who gives way by a set weight of 9, 3 or 1). You said v100's body physics replace hand-tuned shoves. Does this crowd push come over as it is, or should the Mass book (who is heavier gives way) decide who moves?

A priest sent to a shrine stands at the foot of the Throne, which sits on the island in the great lake in the middle. You said the middle stays clear until you describe the reimagined Throne. Does the shrine wait for that?
